## Goal

Run the complete Open Brain memory stack locally from a verified clone of the core01 database, and make Claude-compatible plus Claudex sessions use the local stack for automatic context-pack, reflex, capture, checkpoint, and wrap behavior. Codex integration is deferred.

Parent program: #320

## Scope

- verified, repeatable core01 backup → encrypted transfer → local restore
- loopback-only local PostgreSQL/pgvector, embedding, and Open Brain runtime
- automatic Claude-compatible and Claudex full context-pack plus per-turn reflex recall
- content-free Langfuse lifecycle and recall-quality observability
- local dogfood and #347 tuning before the next core01 rollout

## Constraints

- no production writes from local validation
- no raw prompts, transcripts, retrieved bodies, secrets, paths, tool payloads, or exception strings in telemetry
- functional coverage, not source-coverage targets
- Codex is deferred
- Hermes is not applicable and must not be added, deployed, or canaried
- local verification completes before production deployment
